sentences.en: He is obsequious to the higher-ups and arrogant towards his underlings.
sentences.zh: 他对上司毕恭毕敬，对下属却傲慢无礼。

sentences.en: You're just an underling. Know your place!
sentences.zh: 你只是一个手下。知道自己的位置就行了！

sentences.en: I guess I've reached the age where I have to dispense advice to my underlings.
sentences.zh: 我想我到了该给下属提些建议的年纪了。
